scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I recently applied for a housing loan and I'm wondering about the status of my application. Could you please tell me if it has been approved or denied? Also, what is the interest rate I've been offered?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. The interest rate offered on your loan is 8.875%.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Thank you for letting me know. I also wanted to ask, what are the total costs associated with this loan, and is there a high-cost or negative amortization flag on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The total costs associated with your loan are $2,563.17. This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Could you also tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution, and what type of loan product I've been approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has been sold to a private securitizer. The loan product you've been approved for is a Conventional:Subordinate Lien.

dialogue.user: I see. Just one more thing, what is my debt-to-income ratio, and what does that mean for my application?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is 43%. This ratio represents the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying your debt.

dialogue.user: Thank you for all the information. I feel well-informed about my loan application and the details provided. <Satisfied> The agent was clear, courteous, and provided all the necessary details I needed to know about my loan.
